description: Source code for ECM (Entitlement Control Message) handling in Android's ClearKey CAS implementation, including classes for parsing, decrypting, and managing ECM descriptors and containers.

classes.name: Ecm
classes.description: Handles parsing and decrypting ECM data, manages asset and system IDs, and stores ECM buffer.

classes.name: EcmDescriptor
classes.description: Represents an ECM descriptor, capable of parsing its data and containing an ECM object.

classes.name: EcmContainer
classes.description: Contains one or two ECM descriptors, manages their collection and parsing.

methods.name: Ecm::Ecm
methods.description: Constructor initializing ECM object with default IDs.

methods.name: Ecm::Parse
methods.description: Parses ECM data from a buffer, extracting asset and system IDs.

methods.name: Ecm::Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ECM data using provided asset and updates internal state.

methods.name: EcmDescriptor::EcmDescriptor
methods.description: Constructor for ECM descriptor with default values.

methods.name: EcmDescriptor::EcmDescriptor
methods.description: Constructor initializing ECM descriptor with ID and ECM object.

methods.name: EcmDescriptor::Parse
methods.description: Parses ECM descriptor data from a buffer.

methods.name: EcmContainer::Add
methods.description: Adds an ECM descriptor to the container.

methods.name: EcmContainer::Parse
methods.description: Parses ECM container data from a buffer, extracting descriptors.
